from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u028/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    n, m = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find the rectangular 5-frame and the two color markers outside it.
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(n) for c in range(m) if grid[r][c] == 5]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    markers = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(n) for c in range(m)
               if grid[r][c] not in (0, 5)]
    markers.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
    left, right = markers[0][2], markers[1][2]
    # Markers above the frame label its top half; markers below label its bottom half.
    marker_row = markers[0][0]
    top_first = marker_row < r0
    midr, midc = (r0 + r1 + 1) // 2, (c0 + c1 + 1) // 2
    for r in range(r0 + 1, r1):
        for c in range(c0 + 1, c1):
            top = r < midr
            left_side = c < midc
            same = (top == top_first) == left_side
            out[r][c] = left if same else right
    return out
'''
path=program_dir/'task-6329b9c6.py'
path.write_text(code)
# pair check
